about: CI's test shards (scripts/ci-plan.mjs, scripts/ci-shard.mjs). A pool's shards run its suites, split by file and assigned by time; the pool without suites takes every other one. gh runs on GitHub-hosted runners only, lean holds the suites whose workflows the lean job's validator sweep reads (see ci.yml). The counts here and the matrices in ci.yml must agree (scripts/ci-plan.test.mjs).
